eligibility: Enrolled ERC-8004 identity and a signature from its current NFT holder. No human binding or score required.

marketData.description: Available data families and indicator definitions
Indicator definitions, current observations and quality
Latest stored observation for a metric
Stock evidence, candles and field-level coverage
Instruments in a sector or theme

authentication.scheme: EIP-191 personal_sign; EOA or deployed ERC-1271 current NFT holder
authentication.encoding: Prefix + JSON.stringify(signingPayload), UTF-8, no trailing newline. Reconstruct and byte-compare before signing. Verify origin, identity, action, scopes and expiry locally.
authentication.purpose: Read macro reports, theses, JEV signals and permitted market data. No publishing, funds, transactions or admin access.
authentication.ownership: Checked on every data read. Chain verification failure denies reads, but never prevents logout.
authentication.replay: Challenges are single-use. If the session response is lost, obtain a fresh challenge.

signals.queries: hours: integer 1–12, default 12; limit: 1–100, default 50; cursor: nextCursor. Continue with cursor and limit only, or unchanged hours.
signals.pagination: Encrypted cursor, bound to identity and window; valid for one hour or until service restart. The rolling 12-hour cap applies on every page. Later arrivals are excluded; saved scores may be updated between pages.
signals.cache: Shared 15-second cutoff and bounded cache. No expired-cache fallback.
signals.assessment: A deterministic summary of recorded score, direction and activity, not a new model analysis or an execution recommendation. Score is not a probability. Missing direction remains unknown.
signals.identifiers: Opaque IDs are stable within one service process and change on restart; do not treat them as permanent identifiers.
signals.validity: status is active or expired only when a validUntil is recorded; otherwise unknown. Recomputed on each response. assessment.evaluatedAt preserves the recorded scoring time; asOf is the publication/receipt cutoff, not a historical score snapshot.
signals.timeFilter: Original publication time, lower bound exclusive and cutoff inclusive. No history beyond the latest 12 hours.

queries.metrics: metric_id required; entity optional. Discover both in catalog.
queries.series: limit 1–1000; start and end must be supplied together as ISO timestamps.
queries.lists: limit 1–1000, offset default 0; follow nextOffset. Instrument and transaction source caps are explicitly reported.

marketData.timestamps: sourceReadAt is when NOESIS retrieved the data, not market observation time. Preserve timestamp and fetched_at from each observation.
marketData.freshness: The upstream freshness assessment primarily uses fetched_at; it does not prove the latest official release was collected.
marketData.cache: 30 seconds; catalog 5 minutes. Source timestamps are unchanged. No expired-cache fallback.
excluded: source administration and private account/watchlist notes

data.macro: Latest successfully saved global macro/crypto/technology analysis. Source times and completion time are preserved; no stock rows or diagnostics.

theses.timeFilter: since inclusive, until exclusive; both filter platform receivedAt
theses.pagination: Opaque nextCursor. Keep filters unchanged, or pass cursor and limit only. Cursor valid for one hour; status is evaluated at the first page asOf.
theses.receipt: Stored author claims; not endorsement, adoption, execution or proof of correctness.
